ThingDef.label: cauliflower mushroom

New wild emergence may form irregular same-species clumps of 2–5 plants where space permits. Wild habitat: soil within 2 tiles of a stump, dead tree or living pine at least 50% grown.

Repeated intake cannot extend an episode beyond 24 hours from first exposure. Sleep or incapacitation can end wandering early.
